entries.title: Keep feedback review focused
entries.description: The Feedback inbox and its alert now focus on private feedback requiring review. Public Job feedback remains on the Job without workflow status controls.

entries.title: See more useful dashboard context
entries.description: The streamlined dashboard now shows up to ten scheduled Jobs with the operator and product together, while upcoming deliveries present their key details more compactly.

entries.title: Understand sidebar alerts at a glance
entries.description: Hover over warning dots to see exact counts and what needs attention. The sidebar also shows clear loading and retry states when access cannot be checked.

entries.title: Browse long lists more smoothly
entries.description: The Buy List now loads rows incrementally, and wide tables scroll within their cards instead of stretching the entire page.

entries.title: Review purchasing details more clearly
entries.description: Purchase Order statuses have clearer colors, tables have improved spacing, and quantity and cost fields are easier to read and complete.

entries.title: Use a roomier Job view
entries.description: The Job details panel is wider, giving feedback, documents, assemblies, and other information more space.

entries.title: Reach every area on smaller screens
entries.description: Tabs that cannot fit now move into a More menu, keeping every permitted area accessible without truncated labels.

entries.title: Follow Job progress in a clearer order
entries.description: On phones, routing now appears directly after overall progress, while redundant status chips are removed. Job feedback also reads as straightforward notes without workflow badges.

entries.title: Scan prices and operators faster
entries.description: Product and Quote lists now show rounded whole-currency values, and Stores displays the selected operator’s photo when available.
